title: Design: Row menu of an unused own term looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have the shop's own active term A, due on day 25 of the following month, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p1-04-row-menu-your-term-not-used-yet.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the term A row.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A white menu with a shadow opens under the "⋯", as wide as its longest item, listing in this order: "Edit" (pencil icon), "Make Default for New Customers" (circle with a tick), "Move Customers" (person icon) greyed, "Deactivate" (archive box), a thin divider line, and "Delete Credit Term" (bin icon) in red text with a red icon and no red background (as in ct-p1-04-row-menu-your-term-not-used-yet.png).

Step 2:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions), story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S2-R1: “Each row's "⋯" menu shows only the items that apply to that term, in this order. An item that applies but is blocked shows greyed out and does nothing when clicked; hovering it shows the reason.”
  • S2-R1 table, Edit row: “"Edit" (pencil) | Active terms the shop created | The term is in use: "Used by {holders}" with "Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." below”
  • S2-R1 table, Make Default row: “"Make Default for New Customers" (circle check) | Active terms that are not the default and not Credit Hold | Never”
  • S2-R1 table, Move Customers row: “"Move Customers" (person) | Every term, active or inactive | The user lacks 'Customers → Create & Edit' or 'View and Manage AP/AR Data': "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers." Otherwise no customer holds the term: "No customers are on this term"”
  • S2-R1 table, Deactivate row: “"Deactivate" (archive) | Active terms except COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold | The term is the default: "This is your default for new customers" with "Pick another default first." below”
  • S2-R1 table, Delete Credit Term row: “"Delete Credit Term" (trash, red, last, below a divider) | Terms the shop created, active or inactive | The term is the default: "This is your default for new customers" / "Pick another default first."; otherwise the term is in use: "Used by {holders}" / "Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers."”
  • S4-N2: “If no customer is on the term, "Move Customers" shows greyed with the hover text "No customers are on this term".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
